Recommendations

Outstanding items from lint, consolidation, and the Dream, in one place. Copy a prompt and paste it into Telegram or the terminal to action it.

Dreamcost2026-09-08
Restrict auxiliary fallbacks to free models - auxiliary is engaging a PAID lane
Every time the auxiliary client falls back to OpenRouter it engages a paid SKU. The configured vision model is google/gemini-2.5-flash and the fallback default is deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731, neither of which is a free tier. errors.log records the PAID-lane warning repeatedly (auxiliary vision and the running model both flagged). This is unmonitored spend on top of the primary lane. config.yaml has no auxiliary.free_only: true set, so there is no guard. Fix: set auxiliary.free_only: true (and optionally point auxiliary.openrouter_model at a :free SKU) so background or auxiliary work never burns paid tokens. Frame against billing: on PAYG this is direct AUD via the OpenRouter key; on a flat plan it protects headroom.
10 min/mo
Why we're suggesting this (3)
  • errors.log: 4 x 'PAID lane engaged for auxiliary task' warnings for gemini-2.5-flash on 2026-09-08
  • config.yaml auxiliary.vision.model=google/gemini-2.5-flash; no auxiliary.free_only key present
  • errors.log 11:38:02: main model deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731 also flagged non-free for auxiliary fallback
Consolidationanomaly2026-09-10
Paul Chaina cannot reach Harley in the Telegram group - add him to TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS + gateway restart
Diagnosed 2026-09-10 17:40 ACST: Paul Chaina (Telegram user 5637702477, in the Harley and Paul ABA Trades group) sent a message that was dropped before reaching the agent. The Telegram gateway blocked user 5637702477 as unauthorized at 08:06:58 UTC because TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS only contains Josh (8348712782). Fix requires adding 5637702477 to TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS plus a gateway restart. Flagged to Josh for approval - do not edit config during gateway restarts (Winston coordination).
Why we're suggesting this (2)
  • Agent/Activity.md 2026-09-10 Paul Chaina diagnosis line
  • config.yaml telegram.allowed_chats + TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS env
Dreamworkflow2026-09-10
Email sweep re-fetches lingering self-sent test messages every run - clear them
The nightly/hourly email sweep keeps calling graph-mail.py get on the same self-sent test messages (subject "Email signature", from harley@abatrades.com.au). Over Sep 9-10 the ledger shows 15 get calls on that one message ID across 5 sessions/cron runs, and 5 of them errored (exit 1) before a follow-up retry succeeded. These test emails were already triaged, marked read, and confirmed delivered - they should have been cleaned up instead of left to be re-fetched on every sweep. The intermittent exit-1s are transient graph GET errors hitting a non-actionable message, so the real waste is the redundant work, not a code defect. Fix: delete (or move to trash) the two self-sent test messages ("Test email from Harley", "Email signature") so the sweep stops re-fetching them; going forward, self-sent verification emails should be trashed at send-verification time, not left in the inbox.
20 min/mo
Why we're suggesting this (3)
  • logs/tool-calls.jsonl: 15 x 'graph-mail.py get' on same AAMkID 2026-09-09T03:22 to 2026-09-10T12:34 across 5 sessions
  • logs/tool-calls.jsonl: 5 of those get calls status=error (exit 1), each retried OK within minutes
  • Agent/Activity.md 2026-09-10: both test emails already triaged/read and delivery confirmed
